aiDescription.summary: This bill amends 5 U.S.C. 6103 to set Washington's Birthday on February 22 (instead of the third Monday in February) and to add Lincoln's Birthday to the list of legal public holidays. It revises the federal government's official holiday list under title 5, affecting federal employee leave and federal agency observances.

impact.summary: The bill would amend 5 U.S.C. §6103 to move Washington's Birthday from the third Monday in February to February 22 and to add Lincoln's Birthday as a legal public holiday. That change would alter federal employee leave, pay, and agency closure schedules, affecting executive departments, the U.S. Postal Service, and federal courts; some states and private employers might follow suit.

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.
